    //==
    // # The graph of a 2D scalar field
    //
    // A field over the plane, drawn as the surface z = f(x, y) — the standard
    // reading of a heightfield, a noise field or a potential.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - World space (Z-up), so the field's own two
    // coordinates are X and Y and its value is the elevation.

    // One point of a field's graph: the sample position carrying the field's value
    // there as its elevation.
    GraphPoint(self: IScalarField2D, xy: Point2D): Point3D
        => Point3D(xy.X, xy.Y, self.Eval(xy));
